questions.question: Two pipes can fill a cistern separately in 36 minutes and 45 minutes, respectively. A waste pipe can drain off 40 litres per minute. If all the three pipes are opened, the cistern fills in one hour. The capacity (in litres of the cistern) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two pipes can fill a cistern separately in 36 minutes and 45 minutes, respectively.

A waste pipe can drain off 40 litres per minute.

If all three pipes are opened, the cistern fills in one hour.

**Formula used:**

Let the capacity of the cistern be x litres.

Rate of filling by the first pipe = x / 36 litres/minute

Rate of filling by the second pipe = x / 45 litres/minute

Rate of emptying by the waste pipe = 40 litres/minute

Net rate of filling when all three pipes are open = (x / 36) + (x / 45) - 40 litres/min

Volume of a cube (V) = side³

Surface area of a cube (A) = 6 × side²

**Calculation:**

Given volume, V = 512 cubic units

⇒ side³ = 512

⇒ side = 8 units

Surface area, A = 6 × side²

⇒ A = 6 × 8²

⇒ A = 6 × 64

⇒ A = 384 square units

**∴ The correct answer is 384 square units.**

questions.question: Sohan sells sugar at the cost price but uses false weights thus gaining 28% profit. How many grams of sugar is he giving for 3.2 kg sugar?
questions.solution:

Sohan sells sugar at the cost price but uses false weights thus gaining 28% profit.

Calculation:

Let the actual weight of sugar be W grams.

Since he gains 28% profit, we have:

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) + 28% of CP

SP = CP + 0.28 × CP

SP = 1.28 × CP

Therefore, the weight he is giving is reduced by a factor of 1.28

Weight Sohan is giving = 3.2 kg / 1.28

⇒ Weight Sohan is giving = 3200 grams / 1.28

⇒ Weight Sohan is giving = 2500 grams

**∴ The correct answer is 2500 grams.**

questions.question: If a transversal intersects two parallel lines, and the difference between two interior angles on the same side of the transversal is 40°, then find the smallest angle among the interior angles.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If a transversal intersects two parallel lines, and the difference between two interior angles on the same side of the transversal is 40º, then find the smallest angle among the interior angles.

**Formula used:**

Let the two interior angles on the same side of the transversal be x and y.

Since the lines are parallel, we know:

x + y = 180º (sum of interior angles on the same side of the transversal)

Given: x - y = 40º

**Calculation:**

We have the system of equations:

x + y = 180º

x - y = 40º

Adding these equations:

⇒ (x + y) + (x - y) = 180º + 40º

⇒ 2x = 220º

⇒ x = 110º

Substitute x back into x + y = 180º:

⇒ 110º + y = 180º

⇒ y = 70º

The smallest angle among the interior angles is 70º.

**∴ The correct answer is 70º.**

questions.question: Sudarsan and Abraham appear for an interview for two vacancies. The probability of Sudarsan's selection is (1)/(3)and that of Abraham's selection is (1)/(5). Find the probability that none of them be selected.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Probability of Sudarsan not being selected = 1 − 1/3 = 2/3

Probability of Abraham not being selected = 1 − 1/5 = 4/5

Since the events are independent, the required probability is the product of individual non-selection probabilities.

Required Probability = 2/3 × 4/5 = 8/15

**∴ The correct answer is 8/15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Probability of Sudarsan's selection P(S) = 1/3

Probability of Abraham's selection P(A) = 1/5

**Formula Used:**

For independent events A and B, P(none selected) = P(A') × P(B'), where P(X') = 1 − P(X).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d0bd6f5f00275190d4df4c81c821ebfd19f2794c9684bbcfd3255eb6b511f9a.png] 

Calculations:

⇒ Probability that Sudarsan is not selected P(S') = 1 − 1/3 = 2/3

⇒ Probability that Abraham is not selected P(A') = 1 − 1/5 = 4/5

⇒ Probability (None selected) = P(S') × P(A')

⇒ Required Probability = (2/3) × (4/5)

⇒ Required Probability = (2 × 4) / (3 × 5) = 8/15

**∴ The correct answer is 8/15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Independent Events

Two events are independent if the occurrence of one does not affect the occurrence of the other. For such events, P(A and B) = P(A) × P(B).

Complementary Events

The probability of an event not occurring is 1 minus the probability of the event occurring: P(A') = 1 − P(A).

At Least One Selected

The probability that at least one of them is selected is given by 1 − P(None selected). In this case, 1 − 8/15 = 7/15.</p

questions.question: The age of the father 10 years ago was thrice the age of his son. Ten years hence, the father's age will be twice that of his son. What is the ratio of their present ages?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The age of the father 10 years ago was thrice the age of his son. Ten years hence, the father's age will be twice that of his son.

**Formula used:**

Let the present age of the father be F and the present age of the son be S.

10 years ago: F - 10 = 3(S - 10)

10 years hence: F + 10 = 2(S + 10)

**Calculations:**

From the first equation:

F - 10 = 3(S - 10)

⇒ F - 10 = 3S - 30

⇒ F = 3S - 20

From the second equation:

F + 10 = 2(S + 10)

⇒ F + 10 = 2S + 20

⇒ F = 2S + 10

Equating both expressions for F:

3S - 20 = 2S + 10

⇒ 3S - 2S = 10 + 20

⇒ S = 30

Substitute S into F = 2S + 10:

F = 2(30) + 10

⇒ F = 60 + 10

⇒ F = 70

Therefore, the ratio of their present ages is:

F : S = 70 : 30

⇒ 7 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 7 : 3**

questions.question: A 100 mL solution having 0.01 moles of NaOH dissolved in it. The pH of the solution is:
questions.solution:
__Concept:__

__
 
• pH and pOH: pH is a measure of the hydrogen ion concentration in a solution, while pOH is a measure of the hydroxide ion concentration.
 
• Relationship between pH and pOH: The sum of pH and pOH is always 14 at 25°C.
 
 
• pH + pOH = 14
 
• For a strong base like NaOH, which dissociates completely in water:
 
• NaOH → Na⁺ + OH⁻
 
 

**Calculations:**__

Given that,

__
 
• Volume of solution (V) = 100 mL = 0.1 L
 
• Moles of NaOH = 0.01 moles

The molarity (M) of NaOH solution is given by:

M = \frac{\text{moles of solute}}{\text{volume of solution in liters}}

M = \frac{0.01 \text{ moles}}{0.1 \text{ L}} = 0.1 M

Since NaOH is a strong base, it dissociates completely in water:

[OH⁻] = 0.1 M

pOH is calculated using the formula:

pOH = -log[OH⁻]

pOH = -log(0.1) = 1

Using the relationship between pH and pOH:

pH + pOH = 14

pH = 14 - pOH

pH = 14 - 1 = 13

**So, the pH of the solution is 13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The pH scale ranges from 0 to 14, with 7 being neutral. Values below 7 indicate acidity, and values above 7 indicate alkalinity.
 
• Strong bases like NaOH have high pH values, typically close to 14.

questions.question: A bus moving on a straight road at a speed of 10 km / h increases its speed to 70 km / h in 2 minutes. Find its average acceleration.
questions.solution:
__Concept:__

__
 
• Average acceleration: The change in velocity divided by the time taken to change the velocity is called average acceleration.
 
• Formula for average acceleration: Average acceleration (a) is given by the formula:
 
 
• a = (vf - vᵢ) / t
 
 
 
• Where:
 
 
• vf is the final velocity
 
• vᵢ is the initial velocity
 
• t is the time taken
 
 

**Calculations**__**:**

Given that,

__
 
• Initial velocity, vᵢ = 10 km/h
 
• Final velocity, vf = 70 km/h
 
• Time taken, t = 2 minutes = 2/60 hours = 1/30 hours

So we have a formula for average acceleration,

a = (vf - vᵢ) / t

Substituting the given values:

a = (70 - 10) / (1/30) = 60 × 30 = 1800 km/h²

To convert km/h² to km/min², we divide by 3600 (since 1 hour = 60 minutes and hence (60 minutes)² = 3600 minutes²):

a = 1800 / 3600 = 0.5 km/min²

**So the average acceleration of the bus is 0.5 km/min².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Acceleration is a vector quantity that has both magnitude and direction.
 
• Deceleration is negative acceleration where the speed of an object decreases over time.
 
• In SI units, acceleration is measured in meters per second squared (m/s²).

questions.question: What is the purpose of a search engine on the internet?

options.text: To create and edit documents online.
To search and retrieve relevant information from the web.
To network with people on social media platforms.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To search and retrieve relevant information from the web.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **To search and retrieve relevant information from the web** is the primary purpose of a search engine on the internet.
 
• Search engines use algorithms to index web pages and provide the most relevant results based on the user's query.
 
• Popular search engines include **Google, Bing, and Yahoo**, among others.
 
• They help users find websites, images, videos, and other content online.
 
• Advanced search features may include filters for date, type of content, and specific keywords.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Search engines use **web crawlers** to gather information from websites.
 
• They store data in an **index** to quickly retrieve relevant results.
 
• Search engine optimization (SEO) is a practice to improve the visibility of a website in search engine results.
 
• Search engines also offer features like **autocomplete** to assist users in finding information faster.
 
• Besides web pages, search engines can also index **images, videos, news articles, and academic papers**.
 
• Users can perform **advanced searches** using operators like quotes for exact phrases, minus sign to exclude words, and site: to search within a specific website.

questions.question: Which networking protocol is used to assign IP addresses dynamically to devices on a network?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol)** is the networking protocol used to assign IP addresses dynamically to devices on a network.
 
• It allows devices to join a network without the need for manual configuration of IP addresses.
 
• DHCP operates on a client-server model where the DHCP server assigns an IP address from a defined range to a client device for a specific lease time.
 
• This protocol simplifies the management of IP addresses in large networks and ensures that IP address conflicts are minimized.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FTP (File Transfer Protocol)** is used for transferring files between computers on a network.
 
• **HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol)** is the foundation of data communication for the World Wide Web.
 
• **SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol)** is used for sending emails across networks.
 
• DHCP is a critical protocol in modern networks, ensuring efficient IP address management and reducing administrative overhead.
